{{Quote|This source of propaganda implements forcible training in the precepts of COMPNOR for those convicted of disloyalty.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] describes the Re-Education branch, ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Re-Education''' was a branch of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] members convicted of a crime by [[Internal Affairs/Legends|Internal Affairs]] were sent to Re-Education. Many of the individuals, referred to as "Graduates of Re-Education," returned to work within COMPNOR, but always at a lower-level posting. These "Re-Educated" individuals were reported to react strangely, and that their emotions and speech was disjointed and out of phase.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> According to the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', those sentenced to "Re-Education" were implemented with forcible training in the precepts of COMPNOR.<ref name="IHB" />
